values.note: Electric $20 a night; non-electric $15 (operator's description gives no year; read 2026-11-02).

fees.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Decatur/Park/Slip-Bluff-Park ('Camping fees at Slip Bluff Park are $15 for a non-electric site and $20 for an electric site'), read 2026-11-02

booking.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Decatur/Park/Slip-Bluff-Park ('We do not accept camping reservations. The campground is all first come first serve.'), read 2026-11-02

facilities.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Decatur/Park/Slip-Bluff-Park ('A modern shower house ... allows for showers and flushable toilets. There are also pit toilets, potable water'), read 2026-11-02

summary: Confirmed $20 electric / $15 non-electric, FCFS only, showers, flush and pit toilets, water. Added nothing else; no count, length, amperage or campground season on the county's page. 'Rigs up to 50 ft' isn't on it, left.
flags: Waterfront: 'not waterfront' holds. Imagery shows sites under canopy along the park road (no pads visible); the 16-acre lake is ~400 m south of the pin and the Grand River ~250 m north below the bluff; the small ponds east of the road are under 5 acres. I could not see individual pads, so no re-pin; the pin sits on the park road through the camp area.
Missing phone: Decatur County Conservation office (641) 446-7307, 20401 NW Little River Road, Leon (https://www.mycountyparks.com/County/Decatur). No number on the park page itself.
Rate has no year on the page; the operator's text is undated, stored fee read 2026-10-15 from the same page.
